title: SelfCite: Self-Supervised Alignment for Context Attribution in Large Language Models

layout.note: Three aligned rows, one per context variant, each running from a context-and-query card through a dotted arrow to a probability box; the LLaMA box and the generated response sit in the middle column and two coloured score boxes with curved arrows close the figure at the right.

lesson: To show a reward that compares one quantity under several conditions, redraw the same input card once per condition with coloured bars over what is removed, then carry each condition's colour into its number, its score box and the final equation; emoji can stand in for variables to keep formulas short.
